sources.title: Supertone/supertonic-3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Size At about 99M parameters across the public ONNX assets, Supertonic 3 is much smaller than 0.7B to 2B class open TTS systems. The smaller model size is a practical advantage for download size, startup time, and on-device inference.

sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a 99M-parameter open-weight text-to-speech model from Supertone. Runs on CPU via ONNX Runtime. No GPU. No cloud. No API. 31 languages.

sources.snippet: Supertonic 3 is a lightweight on-device TTS system designed for fast local inference, expanded multilingual coverage, and stable reading.

sources.title: Supertonic 3 - Models
sources.snippet: What's New in Supertonic 3 31 languages: expanded from the 5-language Supertonic 2 release. More stable reading: fewer repeat and skip failures, especially on short and long utterances. Higher speaker similarity: improved similarity across the shared-language set compared with Supertonic 2. Expression tags: supports simple tags such as <laugh>, <breath>, and <sigh>. Custom Voices and Audio ...
